title:
ʀᴏᴍᴀɴᴀ ✨ | ᴡᴏᴍᴇɴ’ꜱ ꜰɪᴛɴᴇꜱꜱ, ᴍɪɴᴅꜱᴇᴛ, ᴀɴᴅ ʀᴇʟᴀᴛɪᴏɴꜱʜɪᴘ ᴄᴏᴀᴄʜ on Instagram: "Hi, I’m Romana! But pretty much only my mom calls me that. Everyone else just calls me Ro 🤍

If you’re here looking for a coach for your fitness + growth journey, let’s see if we relate.

Here’s a lil bit about me:

✨ I’m a coach, wifey, dog mom, podcast host, CEO, conspiracy theorist 😉, avid walker, and personal development enthusiast.

✨ I despise small talk. I’d rather stand in silence in the elevator than discuss the weather 🤷‍♀️. So if you’re someone who values real conversations and transparency, we’ll probably get along great.

✨ I was born in Slovakia, grew up in LA, went to UC Irvine, moved to NYC for musical theatre, started life from scratch in Denver in 2018, and then once again in St. Pete in 2022.

✨ My fitness journey started when I got a job working the front desk at a gym in NYC—which just goes to show that you become who you surround yourself with (so choose wisely!).

✨ I did a bodybuilding show in 2017 because I thought achieving that body would finally make me happy (spoiler: it didn’t).

✨ I’ve completed #75Hard 6 times. I have that challenge to thank for building me into so much of who I am today and opening my eyes to discipline, self-ownership, and mental toughness. (Though these days I’m pursuing a little more of the soft life, but some habits are hard to kick.)

✨ I created both the Rooted Coaching Method and Rooted in Relationships course directly from personal experience—not from a textbook. They were born from the real work I had to do to break my toxic patterns, rebuild my self-worth, reestablish my standards, and stop outsourcing my value to other people’s approval.

✨ I’ve spent the last couple of years transitioning from in-person personal trainer to online coach (with a little PT hybrid mixed in) after realizing that my real passion isn’t just helping women change their bodies—it’s helping them build confidence, self-awareness, and the ability to trust themselves in food, fitness, and relationships.

Thank you for being here—and don’t be afraid to say hello! 🌱🫶"

title:

ONE DAY…

…I’ll start eating better

…I’ll wake up earlier

…I’ll start going for walks

…I’ll start reading

Whatever it might be for you.

But here’s your reminder that “One Day” needs a DAY ONE.

And Day One is scary for everyone. It’s uncomfortable and sometimes even embarrassing.

I had a client once say, “let me get in shape first and then we can start personal training.”

Umm..what? As if I was going to judge him for his chapter 1! Nobody is judging you on your chapter 1 except for those who don’t want to feel left behind as you go improve yourself.

Your “One Day” starts with a choice.

Make it today 🤍

Message me “Rooted” if you’re done saying “one day” and are ready to start your day one.

Let’s do this together.

#startnow #personaldevelopment  #selfgrowth #ﬁtness #fitnesstrainer #fitlife #confidence #fitnessjourney"
